subject: Infra straggle: request for trial top-up and short extension
message_1_subject: Infra straggle: request for trial top-up and short extension
message_1_body:
Hi Kimberly,

Quick note from our side — we hit an unexpected blocker during the QuantDeck <> Redwood connector work this morning. Our SSO adapter is failing intermittently under load (401s when the cache refresh hits) and that’s effectively paused our engineer-driven evaluation. We were counting on completing the connector and running the load tests this week, but the debugging has stretched longer than anticipated.

Two asks: can Redwood provide a short sandbox top-up (tokens/credits) so we don’t exhaust our POC runway, and a 2–3 week trial extension so we can finish the integration and sanity-check the model outputs under production-like traffic? We estimate needing ~25k token-equivalent credits and an extension to Jan 10, 2027 to complete the tests and finalize a recommendation.

I attached an error log and a brief integration plan outlining what we need to finish. Happy to jump on a 30-min call if that helps.

Thanks,
Alex Zhao
VP Engineering, QuantDeck
Attachments: error-log-20261201.txt; integration-plan.pdf
Refer to integration doc: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1qTxExampleIntegrationPlan
message_2_subject: Re: Infra straggle: request for trial top-up and short extension
message_2_body:
Alex —

Thanks for the clear summary and for attaching the logs. Sorry you’re blocked; I know how disruptive that is right before an evaluation milestone. I’ll escalate this internally now.

Immediate plan:
- I can provision a provisional top-up of 25k token-equivalent sandbox credits while we investigate.
- I’ll request a short trial extension to Jan 10, 2027. Final approval needs a quick nod from my manager (looping Rishi).
- Can you confirm the workspace ID and the AWS account/region you’re using for the connector so our infra team can reproduce the 401/refresh pattern? Also tell me if you want an hour of engineering swarming (our on-call infra engineer) — we can schedule Monday morning PST.

If you’re okay, I’ll grant the provisional credits today and come back with formal confirmation once Rishi signs off.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0198

message_3_subject: Re: Infra straggle: request for trial top-up and short extension — APPROVED (provisional)
message_3_body:
Kimberly / Marissa —

I reviewed QuantDeck’s notes and the attached error log. Approve provisional sandbox credit of 25k token-equivalent and extend trial window to 2027-01-10. Please mark this as ‘provisional promo’ and include an internal note requiring the following before we convert to a permanent concession:
- Delivery of final integration runbook and post-mortem of the adapter issue.
- Confirmation of no PII data in the test payloads (compliance team check).
- A follow-up call with solutions engineering to validate performance after fixes.

I’m attaching a short internal approval stub for the promo so operations can reconcile.

-Rishi
Head of Sales Engineering, Redwood Inference
Attachments: promo-approval-note.pdf
message_4_subject: Final: top-up and extension confirmed — QuantDeck POC
message_4_body:
Alex —

Following Rishi’s provisional approval, I’ve applied a 25k token-equivalent sandbox credit to your workspace and extended your trial to 2027-01-10. You should see the credits reflected in the Console under Settings -> Billing -> Credits.

Next steps for us:
1) Please share the workspace ID and the AWS account id so infra can reproduce the 401 and attach logs to the ticket.
2) Confirm whether you’d like an engineering swarming session — we have availability Monday 2026-12-13 10:00–11:00 PST.
3) Once you complete the integration run and runbook, send the post-mortem for compliance review and we’ll close the conditional promo checklist.

If anything changes in the meantime I’m available — and if you want me to loop legal for a formal promo agreement I can do that as well.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
